ma-1.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ وَحْدَهُ، وَالصَّلاَةُ وَالسَّلاَمُ عَلَى مَنْ لاَ نَبِيَّ بَعْدَهُ
ma-1.transliteration: Alḥamdulillahi waḥdah waṣ-ṣalatu was-salam `alā man lā nabiyya ba`dah.
ma-1.translation: All praise is due to Allah alone, and peace and blessings be upon him after whom there is no other Prophet.
ma-1.reference: Anas (RA) said that he heard the Prophet (ﷺ) say: "That I sit with people remembering Almighty Allah from the morning (Fajr) prayer until sunrise is more beloved to me than freeing four slaves from among the Children of Isma'il. That I sit with people remembering Allah from the afternoon ('Asr) prayer, until the sun sets, is more beloved to me than freeing four slaves from among the Children of Isma'il."This was reported by Abu Dawud (No. 3667). Al-Albani graded it good in Sahih Abu Dawud 2/698.
ma-1.virtue: The recommendation to begin supplication with praise to Allah the Exalted and extolling Him, followed by prayers upon the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.

ma-2.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ ﴿اللَّهُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ الْحَيُّ الْقَيُّومُ لاَ تَأْخُذُهُ سِنَةٌ وَلاَ نَوْمٌ لَّهُ مَا فِي السَّمَوَاتِ وَمَا فِي الأَرْضِ مَن ذَا الَّذِي يَشْفَعُ عِنْدَهُ إِلاَّ بِإِذْنِهِ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلاَ يُحِيطُونَ بِشَيْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِ إِلاَّ بِمَا شَاء وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضَ وَلاَ يَؤُودُهُ حِفْظُهُمَا وَهُوَ الْعَلِيُّ الْعَظِيمُ﴾
ma-2.transliteration:
(A`ūdhu billāhi min ash-shaytāni 'r-rajīm)
Allāhu lā ilāha illā huwa ‘l-Ḥayyul-Qayyūm,
lā ta'khudhuhu sinatun wa lā nawm,
lahu mā fis-samāwāti wa māfil-arḍ,
man dhal-ladhī yashfa`u `indahu illā bi'idhnih,
ya`lamu mā bayna aydīhim wa mā khalfahum,
wa lā yuḥīṭūna bishay'im-min `ilmihi illā bimā shā',
wasi`a kursiyyuhus-samāwāti wal-arḍ,
wa lā ya'ūduhu hifẓuhumā,
wa huwal-`Aliyyu‘l-`Aẓīm.
ma-2.translation: Allah! There is none worthy of worship but He, the Ever-Living, the One Who sustains and protects all that exists. Neither slumber nor sleep overtakes Him. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is he that can intercede with Him except with His Permission? He knows what happens to them in this world, and what will happen to them in the Hereafter. And they will never encompass anything of His Knowledge except that which He wills. His Throne extends over the heavens and the earth, and He feels no fatigue in guarding and preserving them. And He is the Most High, the Most Great.
ma-2.reference: It was reported by Al-Hakim 1 / 562, Al-Albani graded it as authentic in Sahihut-Targhib wat-Tarhib 1/273, and traces it to An-Nasa'i and At-Tabarani. He says that At-Tabarani's chain of transmission is reliable (Jayyid).
ma-2.virtue: (Ayat al-Kursi; Al-Qur'an 2:255) Whoever says this when he rises in the morning will be protected from jinns until he retires in the evening, and whoever says it when retiring in the evening will be protected from them until he rises in the morning.

ma-4.arabic: قُلْ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ، ٱللَّهُ ٱلصَّمَدُ، لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ، وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُۥ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌۢ
ma-4.transliteration: Bismillaahir Rahmaanir Raheem "Qul huwal laahu ahad (1) Allah hus-samad (2) Lam yalid wa lam yoolad (3) Wa lam yakul-lahoo kufuwan ahad (4)
ma-4.translation: (1) Say, He is Allah, [who is] One, (2) Allah, the Eternal Refuge.(3) He neither begets nor is born,(4) Nor is there to Him any equivalent.
ma-4.reference: The Hadith was reported by Abu Dawud 4/322, and At-Tirmidhi 5/567. See Al-Albani's Sahih At-Tirmidhi 3/182.
ma-4.virtue: Al-Ikhlas 112:1-4, Al-Falaq 113:1-5, An-Nas 114:1-6. Whoever recites these three times in the morning and in the evening, they will suffice him (as a protection) against everything.

ma-5.arabic: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْفَلَقِ، مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ، وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ، وَمِن شَرِّ ٱلنَّفَّٰثَٰتِ فِى ٱلْعُقَدِ، وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ
ma-5.transliteration: Bismillaahir Rahmaanir Raheem "Qul a'oozu bi rabbil-falaq (1) Min sharri maa khalaq (2) Wa min sharri ghaasiqin izaa waqab (3) Wa min sharrin-naffaa-taati fil 'uqad (4) Wa min sharri haasidin izaa hasad (5)
ma-5.translation: (1) Say, I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak (2) From the evil of that which He created (3) And from the evil of darkness when it settles (4) And from the evil of the blowers in knots (5) And from the evil of an envier when he envies.
ma-5.reference: The Hadith was reported by Abu Dawud 4/322, and At-Tirmidhi 5/567. See Al-Albani's Sahih At-Tirmidhi 3/182.
ma-5.virtue: Al-Ikhlas 112:1-4, Al-Falaq 113:1-5, An-Nas 114:1-6. Whoever recites these three times in the morning and in the evening, they will suffice him (as a protection) against everything.

ma-6.arabic: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلنَّاسِ، مَلِكِ ٱلنَّاسِ، إِلَٰهِ ٱلنَّاسِ، مِن شَرِّ ٱلْوَسْوَاسِ ٱلْخَنَّاسِ، ٱلَّذِى يُوَسْوِسُ فِى صُدُورِ ٱلنَّاسِ، مِنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ
ma-6.transliteration:
Bismillaahir Rahmaanir Raheem "Qul a'oozu birabbin naas (1)
Malikin naas (2)
Ilaahin naas (3)
Min sharril waswaasil khannaas (4)
Allazee yuwaswisu fee sudoorin naas (5)
Minal jinnati wannaas (6)
ma-6.translation: (1) Say, I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind (2) The Sovereign of mankind (3) The God of mankind (4) From the evil of the retreating whisperer (5) Who whispers [evil] into the breasts of mankind (6) From among the jinn and mankind.
ma-6.reference: The Hadith was reported by Abu Dawud 4/322, and At-Tirmidhi 5/567. See Al-Albani's Sahih At-Tirmidhi 3/182.
ma-6.virtue: Al-Ikhlas 112:1-4, Al-Falaq 113:1-5, An-Nas 114:1-6. Whoever recites these three times in the morning and in the evening, they will suffice him (as a protection) against everything.

ma-7.arabic: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْملْكُ لِلَّهِ، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لاَ إِلَهَ إلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْملْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، رَبِّ أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ مَا فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ وَخَيرَ مَا بَعْدَهُ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِي هَذَا الْيَوْمِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهُ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ وَسُوءِ الْكِبَرِ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ فِي النَّارِ وَعَذَابٍ فِي الْقَبْرِ
ma-7.transliteration: Asbahna wa-asbahal-mulku lillah, walhamdu lillah, la ilaha illal-lah, wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, wahuwa AAala kulli shayin qadeer, rabbi as-aluka khayra ma fee hathal-yawm, wakhayra ma baAAdahu, wa-aAAoothu bika min sharri hathal-yawm, washarri ma baAAdahu, rabbi aAAoothu bika minal-kasal, wasoo-il kibar, rabbi aAAoothu bika min AAathabin fin-nar, waAAathabin fil-qabr.
ma-7.translation: We have reached the morning and at this very time unto Allah belongs all sovereignty, and all praise is for Allah. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise, and He is over all things omnipotent. My Lord, I ask You for the good of this day and the good of what follows it and I take refuge in You from the evil of this day and the evil of what follows it. My Lord, I take refuge in You from laziness and senility. My Lord, I take refuge in You from torment in the Fire and punishment in the grave.

ma-9.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِكَ أَصْبَحْنَا، وَبِكَ أَمْسَيْنَا، وَبِكَ نَحْيَا، وَبِكَ نَمُوتُ وَإِلَيْكَ النُّشُورُ
ma-9.transliteration: Allahumma bika asbahna, wabika amsayna, wabika nahya, wabika namootu wa-ilaykan-nushoor.
ma-9.translation: O Allah, by Your leave we have reached the morning and by Your leave we have reached the evening, by Your leave we live and die and unto You is our resurrection
ma-9.reference: Al-Tirmidhi, 5/466, No. 3391, and see: Sahih Al-Tirmidhi 3/142.

ma-11.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَيَّ، وَأَبُوءُ بِذَنْبِي فَاغْفِرْ لِي فَإِنَّهُ لاَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنوبَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ
ma-11.transliteration: Allahumma anta rabbee la ilaha illa ant, khalaqtanee wa-ana AAabduk, wa-ana AAala AAahdika wawaAAdika mas-tataAAt, aAAoothu bika min sharri ma sanaAAt, aboo-o laka biniAAmatika AAalay, wa-aboo-o bithanbee, faghfir lee fa-innahu la yaghfiruth-thunooba illa ant.
ma-11.translation: O Allah, You are my Lord, none has the right to be worshipped except You, You created me and I am Your servant and I abide to Your covenant and promise as best I can, I take refuge in You from the evil of which I have committed.  I acknowledge Your favour upon me and I acknowledge my sin, so forgive me, for verily none can forgive sin except You.
ma-11.virtue: Whoever recites this with conviction in the evening and dies during that night shall enter Paradise, and whoever recites it with conviction in the morning and dies during that day shall enter Paradise

ma-12.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَصْبَحْتُ أُشْهِدُكَ، وَأُشْهِدُ حَمَلَةَ عَرْشِكَ، وَمَلاَئِكَتَكَ، وَجَمِيعَ خَلْقِكَ، أَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ وَحْدَكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ، وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّداً عَبْدُكَ وَرَسُولُكَ
ma-12.transliteration: Allahumma innee asbahtu oshhiduka, wa-osshidu hamalata AAarshika, wamala-ikatika, wajameeAAa khalqika, annaka antal-lahu la ilaha illa ant, wahdaka la shareeka lak, wa-anna Muhammadan AAabduka warasooluka.
ma-12.translation: O Allah, verily I have reached the morning and call on You, the bearers of Your throne, Your angels, and all of Your creation to witness that You are Allah, none has the right to be worshipped except You, alone, without partner, and that Muhammad is Your Servant and Messenger.
ma-12.reference: It was narrated by Abu Dawood, 4/317, No. 5069, and by Al-Bukhari in Al-Adab Al-Mufrad, No. 1201, and by Al-Nasa'i in 'Amal Al-Yawm wal-Laylah, No. 9, and by Ibn Al-Sunni, No. 70. Sheikh Ibn Baz classified the isnad of Al-Nasa'i and Abu Dawood as hasan in Tuhfat Al-Akhyar, p. 23.
ma-12.virtue: Allah will spare whoever says this four times in the morning or evening from the fire of Hell.

ma-14.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ مَا أَصْبَحَ بِي مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ أَوْ بِأَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ فَمِنْكَ وَحْدَكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ، فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ وَلَكَ الشُّكْرُ
ma-14.transliteration: Allahumma ma asbaha bee min niAAmatin, aw bi-ahadin min khalqika, faminka wahdaka la shareeka lak, falakal-hamdu walakash-shukr.
ma-14.translation: O Allah, what blessing I or any of Your creation have risen upon is from You alone, without partner. So for You is all praise and unto You all thanks.
ma-14.reference: It was narrated by Abu Dawood, 4/318, No. 5073, and by Al-Nasa'i in 'Amal Al-Yawm wal-Laylah, No. 7, and by Ibn Al-Sunni, No. 41, and by Ibn Hibban in Mawarid, No. 2361. Sheikh Ibn Baz classified the isnad as hasan in Tuhfat Al-Akhyar, p. 24.
ma-14.virtue: Whoever recites this in the morning, has completed his obligation to thank Allah for that day; and whoever says it in the evening, has completed his obligation for that night.

ma-16.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَدَنِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي سَمْعِي، اللَّهُمَّ عَافِنِي فِي بَصَرِي، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ. اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكُفْرِ، وَالفَقْرِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابِ القَبْرِ، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ
ma-16.transliteration: (Allahumma AAafinee fee badanee, allahumma AAafinee fee samAAee, allahumma AAafinee fee basaree, la ilaha illa ant.) (Allahumma innee aAAoothu bika minal-kufr, walfaqr, wa-aAAoothu bika min AAathabil-qabr, la ilaha illa ant.)
ma-16.translation: (O Allah, grant my body health, O Allah, grant my hearing health, O Allah, grant my sight health.  None has the right to be worshipped except You.) (O Allah, I take refuge with You from disbelief and poverty, and I take refuge with You from the punishment of the grave.  None has the right to be worshipped except You.)
ma-16.reference: Abu Dawud 4/324, Ahmad 5/42, An-Nasa'i, 'Amalul-Yawm wal-Laylah (No. 22), Ibn As-Sunni (No. 69), Al-Bukhari Al-'Adab Al-Mufrad. Its chain of transmission is good (Hasan), Ibn Baz, p. 26.

ma-17.arabic: حَسْبِيَ اللَّهُ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ هُوَ عَلَيهِ تَوَكَّلتُ وَهُوَ رَبُّ الْعَرْشِ الْعَظِيمِ
ma-17.transliteration: Hasbiyal-lahu la ilaha illa huwa, AAalayhi tawakkalt, wahuwa rabbul-AAarshil-AAatheem
ma-17.translation: Allah is Sufficient for me, none has the right to be worshipped except Him, upon Him I rely and He is Lord of the exalted throne.
ma-17.reference: It was narrated by Ibn As-Sunni, No. 71, attributed directly to the Prophet (Marfu'), and by Abu Dawud as a statement of a Companion (Mawquf), 4/321, No. 5081. The chain of transmission was authenticated by Shu'ayb and 'Abd al-Qadir al-Arna'ut. See: Zad Al-Ma'ad 2/376.
ma-17.virtue: Allah will grant whoever recites this seven times in the morning or evening whatever he desires from this world or the next

ma-18.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالآخِرَةِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ: فِي دِينِي وَدُنْيَايَ وَأَهْلِي، وَمَالِي، اللَّهُمَّ اسْتُرْ عَوْرَاتِي، وَآمِنْ رَوْعَاتِي، اللَّهُمَّ احْفَظْنِي مِنْ بَينِ يَدَيَّ، وَمِنْ خَلْفِي، وَعَنْ يَمِينِي، وَعَنْ شِمَالِي، وَمِنْ فَوْقِي، وَأَعُوذُ بِعَظَمَتِكَ أَنْ أُغْتَالَ مِنْ تَحْتِي
ma-18.transliteration: Allahumma innee as-alukal-AAafwa walAAafiyah, fid-dunya wal-akhirah, allahumma innee as-alukal-AAafwa walAAafiyah fee deenee, wadunyaya wa-ahlee, wamalee, allahummas-tur AAawratee, wa-amin rawAAatee, allahummah-fathnee min bayni yaday, wamin khalfee, waAAan yameenee, waAAan shimalee, wamin fawqee, wa-aAAoothu biAAathamatika an oghtala min tahtee.
ma-18.translation: O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in this life and the next. O Allah, I ask You for pardon and well-being in my religious and worldly affairs, and my family and my wealth. O Allah, veil my weaknesses and set at ease my dismay. O Allah, preserve me from the front and from behind and on my right and on my left and from above, and I take refuge with You lest I be swallowed up by the earth.
ma-18.reference: Abu Dawood, No. 5074, and Ibn Majah, No. 3871. See: Sahih Ibn Majah, 2/332.

ma-19.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ عَالِمَ الغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ فَاطِرَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالْأَرْضِ، رَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَمَلِيكَهُ، أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي، وَمِنْ شَرِّ الشَّيْطانِ وَشَرَكِهِ، وَأَنْ أَقْتَرِفَ عَلَى نَفْسِي سُوءاً، أَوْ أَجُرَّهُ إِلَى مُسْلِمٍ
ma-19.transliteration: Allahumma AAalimal-ghaybi washshahadah, fatiras-samawati wal-ard, rabba kulli shayin wamaleekah, ashhadu an la ilaha illa ant, aAAoothu bika min sharri nafsee wamin sharrish-shaytani washirkih, waan aqtarifa AAala nafsee soo-an aw ajurrahu ila muslim.
ma-19.translation: (O Allah, Knower of the unseen and the seen, Creator of the heavens and the Earth, Lord and Sovereign of all things, I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped except You. I take refuge in You from the evil of my soul and from the evil and shirk of the devil, and from committing wrong against my soul or bringing such upon another Muslim.)(shirk: to associate others with Allah in those things which are specific to Him.  This can occur in (1) belief, e.g. to believe that other than Allah has the power to benefit or harm, (2) speech, e.g. to swear by other than Allah and (3) action, e.g. to bow or prostrate to other than Allah.)
ma-19.reference: Al-Tirmidhi, No. 3392, and Abu Dawood, No. 5067. See: Sahih Al-Tirmidhi, 3/142.

ma-20.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الَّذِي لاَ يَضُرُّ مَعَ اسْمِهِ شَيْءٌ فِي الْأَرْضِ وَلاَ فِي السّمَاءِ وَهُوَ السَّمِيعُ الْعَلِيمُ
ma-20.transliteration: Bismil-lahil-lathee la yadurru maAAas-mihi shay-on fil-ardi wala fis-sama-i wahuwas-sameeAAul-AAaleem.
ma-20.translation: In the name of Allah with whose name nothing is harmed on earth nor in the heavens and He is The All-Seeing, The All-Knowing.
ma-20.reference: It was narrated by Abu Dawood, 4/323, No. 5088, Al-Tirmidhi, 5/465, No. 3388, Ibn Majah, No. 3869, and Ahmad, No. 446. See: Sahih Ibn Majah, 2/332. Sheikh Ibn Baz classified the isnad as hasan in Tuhfat Al-Akhyar, p. 39.
ma-20.virtue: Whoever recites it three times in the morning will not be afflicted by any calamity before evening, and whoever recites it three times in the evening will not be overtaken by any calamity before morning.

ma-21.arabic: رَضِيتُ بِاللَّهِ رَبَّاً، وَبِالْإِسْلاَمِ دِيناً، وَبِمُحَمَّدٍ ﷺ نَبِيًّا
ma-21.transliteration: Radeetu billahi rabban wabil-islami deenan wabiMuhammadin nabiyya.
ma-21.translation: I am pleased with Allah as a Lord, and Islam as a religion and Muhammad  as a Prophet.
ma-21.reference: Ahmad, 4/337, No. 18967, Al-Nasa'i in 'Amal Al-Yawm wal-Laylah, No. 4, Ibn Al-Sunni, No. 68, Abu Dawood, 4/318, No. 1531, and Al-Tirmidhi, 5/465, No. 3389. Sheikh Ibn Baz classified it as hasan in Tuhfat Al-Akhyar, p. 39.
ma-21.virtue: Allah has promised that anyone who says this three times every morning or evening will be pleased on the Day of Resurrection.

ma-22.arabic: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ بِرَحْمَتِكَ أَسْتَغيثُ أَصْلِحْ لِي شَأْنِيَ كُلَّهُ وَلاَ تَكِلْنِي إِلَى نَفْسِي طَرْفَةَ عَيْنٍ
ma-22.transliteration: Ya hayyu ya qayyoom, birahmatika astagheeth, aslih lee sha/nee kullah, wala takilnee ila nafsee tarfata AAayn.
ma-22.translation: O Ever Living, O Self-Subsisting and Supporter of all, by Your mercy I seek assistance, rectify for me all of my affairs and do not leave me to myself, even for the blink of an eye.
ma-22.reference: Its chain of transmission is sound (Sahih), Al-Hakim 1/545, see Albani, Sahihut-Targhib wat-Tarhib, 1/273.

ma-23.arabic: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمِينَ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هَذَا الْيَوْمِ: فَتْحَهُ، وَنَصْرَهُ، وَنورَهُ، وَبَرَكَتَهُ، وَهُدَاهُ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فِيهِ وَشَرِّ مَا بَعْدَهُ
ma-23.transliteration: Asbahna wa-asbahal-mulku lillahi rabbil-AAalameen, allahumma innee as-aluka khayra hathal-yawm, fat-hahu, wanasrahu, wanoorahu, wabarakatahu, wahudahu, wa-aAAoothu bika min sharri ma feehi, washarri ma baAAdah.
ma-23.translation: We have reached the morning and at this very time all sovereignty belongs to Allah, Lord of the worlds. O Allah, I ask You for the good of this day, its triumphs and its victories, its light and its blessings and its guidance, and I take refuge in You from the evil of this day and the evil that follows it.
ma-23.reference: Abu Dawud 4/322. Its transmission chain is good (Hasan). See also Ibn Al-Qayyim, Zadul- Ma'ad 2/273.

ma-25.arabic: أَصْبَحْنا عَلَى فِطْرَةِ الْإِسْلاَمِ، وَعَلَى كَلِمَةِ الْإِخْلاَصِ، وَعَلَى دِينِ نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ ﷺ، وَعَلَى مِلَّةِ أَبِينَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَنِيفاً مُسْلِماً وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشرِكِينَ
ma-25.transliteration: Asbahna AAala fitratil-islam, waAAala kalimatil-ikhlas, waAAala deeni nabiyyina Muhammad ﷺ, waAAala millati abeena Ibraheem, haneefan musliman wama kana minal-mushrikeen.
ma-25.translation: We rise upon the fitrah of Islam, and the word of pure faith, and upon the religion of our Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, and the religion of our forefather Ibraheem, who was a Muslim and of true faith and was not of those who associate others with Allah.
ma-25.reference: Ahmad, 3/406 and 407, nos. 15360 and 15563, and Ibn Al-Sunni in 'Amal Al-Yawm wal-Laylah, No. 34. See: Sahih Al-Jami', 4/209.

ma-27.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْماً نَافِعاً، وَرِزْقاً طَيِّباً، وَعَمَلاً مُتَقَبَّلاً
ma-27.transliteration: Allahumma innee as-aluka AAilman nafiAAan, warizqan tayyiban, waAAamalan mutaqabbalan.
ma-27.translation: O Allah, I ask You for knowledge which is beneficial and sustenance which is good, and deeds which are acceptable.
ma-27.reference: It was narrated by Ibn Al-Sunni in 'Amal Al-Yawm wal-Laylah, No. 54, and by Ibn Majah, No. 925. The chain of transmission was classified as hasan by 'Abd al-Qadir and Shu'ayb al-Arna'ut in their verification of Zad Al-Ma'ad, 2/375.

ma-28.arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ، وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
ma-28.transliteration: La ilaha illal-lah, wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, wahuwa AAala kulli shay-in qadeer.
ma-28.translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise, and He is over all things omnipotent.
ma-28.countLabel: Ten times or once when lazy
ma-28.reference: Sahih Al-Bukhari: 6404, Sahih Muslim: 2693, Al-Nasa'i in 'Amal Al-Yawm wal-Laylah, No. 24. See: Sahih Al-Targhib wal-Tarhib, 1/272, Tuhfat Al-Akhyar by Ibn Baz, p. 44, and its virtue in: p. 146, hadith No. 255. Once when feeling lazy: Abu Dawood, No. 5077, Ibn Majah, No. 3798, Ahmad, No. 8719. See: Sahih Al-Targhib wal-Tarhib, 1/270, Sahih Abi Dawood, 3/957, Sahih Ibn Majah, 2/331, and Zad Al-Ma'ad, 2/377.
ma-28.virtue: Ten times or once when feeling lazy, and whoever says it ten times, it is as if he has freed four souls from the descendants of Isma'il.

ma-29.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ عَلَى نَبَيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ
ma-29.transliteration: Allaahumma salli wa sallim 'alaa Nabiyyinaa Muhammadin
ma-29.translation: O Allaah, send prayers and peace upon our Prophet Muhammad.
ma-29.reference: It was narrated by Al-Tabarani with two isnads, one of which is good. See: Majma' Al-Zawa'id, 10/120, and Sahih Al-Targhib wal-Tarhib, 1/273 [No. 656], and Da'if Al-Targhib wal-Tarhib, No. 396, and in Al-Silsilah Al-Da'ifah, No. 5788.
ma-29.virtue: The Prophet (ﷺ) said: "Who recites blessings upon me ten times in the morning and ten times in the evening will obtain my intercession on the Day of Resurrection.

ma-31.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ: عَدَدَ خَلْقِهِ، وَرِضَا نَفْسِهِ، وَزِنَةَ عَرْشِهِ، وَمِدَادَ كَلِمَاتِهِ
ma-31.transliteration: Subhanal-lahi wabihamdih, AAadada khalqihi warida nafsih, wazinata AAarshih, wamidada kalimatih.
ma-31.translation: How perfect Allah is and I praise Him by the number of His creation and His pleasure, and by the weight of His throne, and the ink of His words.

ma-32.arabic: لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ، وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
ma-32.transliteration: La ilaha illal-lah, wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, wahuwa AAala kulli shay-in qadeer.
ma-32.translation: None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise, and He is over all things omnipotent.
ma-32.reference: Al-Bukhari, 4/95, No. 3293, and Muslim, 4/2071, No. 2691. Ten times: Al-Nasa'i in 'Amal Al-Yawm wal-Laylah, No. 24. See: Sahih Al-Targhib wal-Tarhib, 1/272, and Tuhfat Al-Akhyar by Ibn Baz, p. 44, and its virtue in: p. 146, hadith No. 255. Once when feeling lazy: Abu Dawood, No. 5077, Ibn Majah, No. 3798, Ahmad, No. 8719. See: Sahih Al-Targhib wal-Tarhib, 1/270, Sahih Abi Dawood, 3/957, Sahih Ibn Majah, 2/331, and Zad Al-Ma'ad, 2/377.
ma-32.virtue: Whoever recites this one hundred times a day will have the reward of freeing ten slaves. One hundred Hasanaat (rewards) will be written for him and one hundred misdeeds will be washed away. He will be shielded from Satan until the evening. No one will be able to present anything better than this except for someone who has recited more than this.

ma-33.translation: I seek Allaah’s forgiveness and I turn to Him in repentance.

ma-34.translation: How perfect Allah is and I praise Him.
ma-34.virtue: Whoever recites this one hundred times in the morning and in the evening will not be surpassed on the Day of Resurrection by anyone having done better than this except for someone who had recited it more.

ma-3.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيطَانِ الرَّجِيمِ ﴿آمَنَ الرَّسُولُ بِمَا أُنزِلَ إِلَيْهِ مِن رَّبِّهِ وَالْمُؤْمِنُونَ كُلٌّ آمَنَ بِاللَّهِ وَمَلآئِكَتِهِ وَكُتُبِهِ وَرُسُلِهِ لاَ نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍ مِّن رُّسُلِهِ وَقَالُواْ سَمِعْنَا وَأَطَعْنَا غُفْرَانَكَ رَبَّنَا وَإِلَيْكَ الْمَصِيرُ* لاَ يُكَلِّفُ اللَّهُ نَفْساً إِلاَّ وُسْعَهَا لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتْ وَعَلَيْهَا مَا اكْتَسَبَتْ رَبَّنَا لاَ تُؤَاخِذْنَا إِن نَّسِينَا أَوْ أَخْطَأْنَا رَبَّنَا وَلاَ تَحْمِلْ عَلَيْنَا إِصْراً كَمَا حَمَلْتَهُ عَلَى الَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِنَا رَبَّنَا وَلاَ تُحَمِّلْنَا مَا لاَ طَاقَةَ لَنَا بِهِ وَاعْفُ عَنَّا وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا وَارْحَمْنَآ أَنتَ مَوْلاَنَا فَانصُرْنَا عَلَى الْقَوْمِ الْكَافِرِينَ﴾. [البقرة 285 - 286]
ma-3.transliteration:
Aamanar-Rasoolu bimaaa unzila ilaihi mir-Rabbihee walmu'minoon; kullun aamana billaahi wa Malaaa'ikathihee wa Kutubhihee wa Rusulihee laa nufarriqu baina ahadim-mir-Rusulih wa qaaloo sami'naa wa ata'naa ghufraanaka Rabbanaa wa ilaikal-maseer (285)
Laa yukalliful-laahu nafsan illaa wus'ahaa; lahaa maa kasabat wa 'alaihaa maktasabat; Rabbanaa laa tu'aakhiznaaa in naseenaaa aw akhtaanaa; Rabbanaa wa laa tahmil-'alainaaa isran kamaa hamaltahoo 'alal-lazeena min qablinaa; Rabbanaa wa laa tuhammilnaa maa laa taaqata lanaa bih; wa'fu 'annaa waghfir lanaa warhamnaa; Anta mawlaanaa fansurnaa 'alal qawmil kaafireen (286)
ma-3.translation: (285) The Messenger has believed in what was revealed to him from his Lord, and [so have] the believers. All of them have believed in Allah and His angels and His books and His messengers, [saying], We make no distinction between any of His messengers. And they say, We hear and we obey. [We seek] Your forgiveness, our Lord, and to You is the [final] destination. (286) Allah does not charge a soul except [with that within] its capacity. It will have [the consequence of] what [good] it has gained, and it will bear [the consequence of] what [evil] it has earned. Our Lord, do not impose blame upon us if we have forgotten or erred. Our Lord, and lay not upon us a burden like that which You laid upon those before us. Our Lord, and burden us not with that which we have no ability to bear. And pardon us; and forgive us; and have mercy upon us. You are our protector, so give us victory over the disbelieving people.
ma-3.reference: It was narrated by Al-Bukhari, No. 4008, and Muslim, No. 807.
ma-3.virtue: Al-Baqarah 2:285-6. These two Verses will be sufficient for anyone who recites them at night before sleeping.

ma-8.arabic: أمسينا وأمسى الملك للَّه، وَالْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ، لاَ إِلَهَ إلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ، رب أسألك خير ما في هذه الليلة، وخير ما بعدها، وأعوذ بك من شر ما في هذه الليلة، وشر ما بعدها، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْكَسَلِ وَسُوءِ الْكِبَرِ، رَبِّ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ عَذَابٍ فِي النَّارِ وَعَذَابٍ فِي الْقَبْرِ
ma-8.transliteration: Amsayna wa-amsal-mulku lillah, walhamdu lillah, la ilaha illal-lah, wahdahu la shareeka lah, lahul-mulku walahul-hamd, wahuwa AAala kulli shayin qadeer, rabbi as-aluka khayra ma fee hathihil-laylah, wakhayra ma baAAdaha, wa-aAAoothu bika min sharri hathihil-laylah, washarri ma baAAdaha, rabbi aAAoothu bika minal-kasal, wasoo-il kibar, rabbi aAAoothu bika min AAathabin fin-nar, waAAathabin fil-qabr.
ma-8.translation: We have reached the evening and at this very time unto Allah belongs all sovereignty, and all praise is for Allah. None has the right to be worshipped except Allah, alone, without partner, to Him belongs all sovereignty and praise, and He is over all things omnipotent. My Lord, I ask You for the good of this night and the good of what follows it and I take refuge in You from the evil of this night and the evil of what follows it. My Lord, I take refuge in You from laziness and senility. My Lord, I take refuge in You from torment in the Fire and punishment in the grave.

ma-10.arabic: اللَّهمَّ بِكَ أمسَينا وبِكَ أصبَحنا وبِكَ نَحيا وبِكَ نموتُ، وإليكَ المصيرُ
ma-10.transliteration: Allahumma bika amsayna, wabika asbahna, wabika nahya, wabika namootu wa-ilaykal-maseer.
ma-10.translation: O Allah, by Your leave we have reached the evening and by Your leave we have reached the morning, by Your leave we live and die and unto You is our return.
ma-10.reference: Al-Tirmidhi, 5/466, No. 3391, and see: Sahih Al-Tirmidhi 3/142.

ma-13.arabic: اللَّهم إني أمسيت أُشْهِدُكَ، وَأُشْهِدُ حَمَلَةَ عَرْشِكَ، وَمَلاَئِكَتَكَ، وَجَمِيعَ خَلْقِكَ، أَنَّكَ أَنْتَ اللَّهُ لَا إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ وَحْدَكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ، وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّداً عَبْدُكَ وَرَسُولُكَ
ma-13.transliteration: Allahumma innee amsaytu oshhiduka, wa-osshidu hamalata AAarshika, wamala-ikatika, wajameeAAa khalqika, annaka antal-lahu la ilaha illa ant, wahdaka la shareeka lak, wa-anna Muhammadan AAabduka warasooluka.
ma-13.translation: O Allah, verily I have reached the evening and call on You, the bearers of Your throne, Your angels, and all of Your creation to witness that You are Allah, none has the right to be worshipped except You, alone, without partner, and that Muhammad is Your Servant and Messenger.
ma-13.reference: It was narrated by Abu Dawood, 4/317, No. 5069, and by Al-Bukhari in Al-Adab Al-Mufrad, No. 1201, and by Al-Nasa'i in 'Amal Al-Yawm wal-Laylah, No. 9, and by Ibn Al-Sunni, No. 70. Sheikh Ibn Baz classified the isnad of Al-Nasa'i and Abu Dawood as hasan in Tuhfat Al-Akhyar, p. 23.
ma-13.virtue: Allah will spare whoever says this four times in the morning or evening from the fire of Hell.

ma-15.arabic: اللَّهم ما أمسى بي مِنْ نِعْمَةٍ أَوْ بِأَحَدٍ مِنْ خَلْقِكَ فَمِنْكَ وَحْدَكَ لاَ شَرِيكَ لَكَ، فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ وَلَكَ الشُّكْرُ
ma-15.transliteration: Allahumma ma amsa bee min niAAmatin, aw bi-ahadin min khalqika, faminka wahdaka la shareeka lak, falakal-hamdu walakash-shukr.
ma-15.translation: O Allah, what blessing I or any of Your creation have reached the evening upon is from You alone, without partner. So for You is all praise and unto You all thanks
ma-15.reference: It was narrated by Abu Dawood, 4/318, No. 5073, and by Al-Nasa'i in 'Amal Al-Yawm wal-Laylah, No. 7, and by Ibn Al-Sunni, No. 41, and by Ibn Hibban in Mawarid, No. 2361. Sheikh Ibn Baz classified the isnad as hasan in Tuhfat Al-Akhyar, p. 24.
ma-15.virtue: Whoever recites this in the morning, has completed his obligation to thank Allah for that day; and whoever says it in the evening, has completed his obligation for that night.

ma-24.arabic: أَمْسَيْنا وَأَمْسَى الْمُلْكُ للهِ رَبِّ الْعَالَمَيْنِ، اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّي أسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَ هَذَه اللَّيْلَةِ فَتْحَهَا ونَصْرَهَا، ونُوْرَهَا وبَرَكَتهَا، وَهُدَاهَا، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا فيهِا وَشَرَّ مَا بَعْدَهَا
ma-24.transliteration: Amsayna wa-amsal-mulku lillahi rabbil-AAalameen, allahumma innee as-aluka khayra hathihil-laylah, fat-haha, wanasraha, wanooraha, wabarakataha, wahudaha, wa-aAAoothu bika min sharri ma feeha, washarri ma baAAdaha.
ma-24.translation: We have reached the evening and at this very time all sovereignty belongs to Allah, Lord of the worlds. O Allah, I ask You for the good of tonight, its triumphs and its victories, its light and its blessings and its guidance, and I take refuge in You from the evil of tonight and the evil that follows it.
ma-24.reference: Abu Dawud 4/322. Its transmission chain is good (Hasan). See also Ibn Al-Qayyim, Zadul- Ma'ad 2/273.

ma-26.arabic: أمسينا على فطرة الإسلام، وَعَلَى كَلِمَةِ الْإِخْلاَصِ، وَعَلَى دِينِ نَبِيِّنَا مُحَمَّدٍ ﷺ، وَعَلَى مِلَّةِ أَبِينَا إِبْرَاهِيمَ، حَنِيفاً مُسْلِماً وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُشرِكِينَ
ma-26.transliteration: Amsayna AAala fitratil-islam, waAAala kalimatil-ikhlas, waAAala deeni nabiyyina Muhammad ﷺ, waAAala millati abeena Ibraheem, haneefan musliman wama kana minal-mushrikeen.
ma-26.translation: We have entered the evening upon the fitrah of Islam, and the word of pure faith, and upon the religion of our Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, and the religion of our forefather Ibraheem, who was a Muslim and of true faith and was not of those who associate others with Allah.
ma-26.reference: Ahmad, 3/406 and 407, nos. 15360 and 15563, and Ibn Al-Sunni in 'Amal Al-Yawm wal-Laylah, No. 34. See: Sahih Al-Jami', 4/209.

ma-30.arabic: أَعُوذُ بِكَلِمَاتِ اللَّهِ التَّامَّاتِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ
ma-30.transliteration: aAAoothu bikalimatil-lahit-tammati min sharri ma khalaq.
ma-30.translation: I take refuge in Allah’s perfect words from the evil He has created.
ma-30.reference: Ahmad 2/ 290, An-Nasa'i, 'Amalul-Yawm wal-Laylah No. 590, At-Tirmidhi 3/187, Ibn As-Sunni No. 68. According to Al-Albani, Ibn Majah's (2/266) chain of transmission is sound (Sahih), and following Ibn Baz 45, At-Tirmidhi's report is good (Hasan).
ma-30.virtue: Whoever recites this three times in the evening will be protected from insect stings

fh-dhikr-after-salah-0.title: Istighfar
fh-dhikr-after-salah-0.virtue: When the Messenger of Allah, sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam, finished his prayer, he would seek forgiveness three times and recite the dhikr above. Al-Auza'i stated that the recitation of istighfar is 'Astaghfirullah, Astaghfirullah.'

fh-dhikr-after-salah-1.title: Allah, The Giver of Peace
fh-dhikr-after-salah-1.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ السَّلاَمُ، وَمِنْكَ السَّلاَمُ، تَبَارَكْتَ يَا ذَا الْجَلاَلِ وَاْلإِكْرَامِ
fh-dhikr-after-salah-1.transliteration: allahumma antas-salam wa minkas-salam tabarakta ya dhal-jalali wal-ikram
fh-dhikr-after-salah-1.translation: O Allah, You are Peace, and from You is peace. Blessed are You, O Possessor of majesty and honor.
fh-dhikr-after-salah-1.virtue: When the Messenger of Allah, sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam, finished his prayer, he would seek forgiveness three times and recite the dhikr above. Al-Auza'i stated that the recitation of istighfar is 'Astaghfirullah, Astaghfirullah.'

fh-dhikr-after-salah-2.title: Allah, The Preventer and The Giver of All Things
fh-dhikr-after-salah-2.arabic: لاَ إِلَـهَ إِلاَّ اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيْكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيْرُ، اَللَّهُمَّ لاَ مَانِعَ لِمَا أَعْطَيْتَ، وَلاَ مُعْطِيَ لِمَا مَنَعْتَ، وَلاَ يَنْفَعُ ذَا الْجَدِّ مِنْكَ الْجَدُّ
fh-dhikr-after-salah-2.transliteration: la ilaha illa allah wahdahu la sharika lah, lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir. allahumma la mani'a lima a'tayta wa la mu'tiya lima mana'ta wa la yanfa'u dhal-jaddi minkal-jaddu
fh-dhikr-after-salah-2.translation: There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah alone, He has no partner. To Him belongs dominion and praise, and He is over all things competent. O Allah, there is no preventer of what You give, and no giver of what You withhold, and wealth and honor do not benefit their possessor (except faith and righteous deeds that save from punishment). Only from You is wealth and honor.
fh-dhikr-after-salah-2.reference: HR. Bukhari No. 844 and Muslim No. 593

fh-dhikr-after-salah-3.title: Allah, The Possessor of All and The Only One Worthy of Worship
fh-dhikr-after-salah-3.arabic: لاَ إِلَـهَ إِلاَّ اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيْكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيْرُ. لاَ حَوْلَ وَلاَ قُوَّةَ إِلاَّ بِاللهِ، لاَ إِلَـهَ إِلاَّ اللهُ، وَلاَ نَعْبُدُ إِلاَّ إِيَّاهُ، لَهُ النِّعْمَةُ وَلَهُ الْفَضْلُ وَلَهُ الثَّنَاءُ الْحَسَنُ، لاَ إِلَـهَ إِلاَّ اللهُ مُخْلِصِيْنَ لَهُ الدِّيْنَ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ الْكَافِرُوْنَ
fh-dhikr-after-salah-3.transliteration: la ilaha illa allah wahdahu la sharika lah. lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir. la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah. la ilaha illa allah wa la na'budu illa iyyah. lahun-ni'mah wa lahul-fadl wa lahuth-thana'ul-hasan. la ilaha illa allah mukhlisina lahud-dina wa law karihal-kafirun
fh-dhikr-after-salah-3.translation: There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah alone, He has no partner. To Him belongs dominion and praise, and He is over all things competent. There is no power and no strength except by Allah. There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah, and we do not worship except Him. To Him belongs all favor, grace, and good praise. There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah, making our religion sincerely for Him, even if the disbelievers dislike it.
fh-dhikr-after-salah-3.virtue: 'Abdullah bin Zubair said, "The Prophet, sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam, used to recite the tahlil (laa ilaha illallah) at the end of the prayer."

fh-dhikr-after-salah-7.title: There is No Partner for Allah, and To Him Belongs All Things
fh-dhikr-after-salah-7.arabic: لاَ إِلَـهَ إِلاَّ اللهُ وَحْدَهُ لاَ شَرِيْكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيْرُ
fh-dhikr-after-salah-7.transliteration: la ilaha illa allah wahdahu la sharika lah. lahul-mulku wa lahul-hamdu wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir
fh-dhikr-after-salah-7.translation: There is no deity worthy of worship except Allah alone, He has no partner. To Him belongs dominion and praise, and He is over all things competent.
fh-dhikr-after-salah-7.virtue: Whoever recites the dhikr above, his sins will be forgiven, even if they are as numerous as the foam on the ocean. Imam Nawawi, may Allah have mercy on him, said that the text of the hadith indicates that 'Subhanallah', 'Alhamdulillah', and 'Allahu akbar' are each recited 33 times separately.

fh-dhikr-after-salah-8.title: Ayat al-Kursi
fh-dhikr-after-salah-8.arabic: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلْحَىُّ ٱلْقَيُّومُ ۚ لَا تَأْخُذُهُۥ سِنَةٌ وَلَا نَوْمٌ ۚ لَّهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ مَن ذَا ٱلَّذِى يَشْفَعُ عِندَهُۥٓ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِهِۦ ۚ يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ ۖ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِشَىْءٍ مِّنْ عِلْمِهِۦٓ إِلَّا بِمَا شَآءَ ۚ وَسِعَ كُرْسِيُّهُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ ۖ وَلَا يَـُٔودُهُۥ حِفْظُهُمَا ۚ وَهُوَ ٱلْعَلِىُّ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
fh-dhikr-after-salah-8.transliteration: allahu la ilaha illa huwa, al-hayyul-qayyum. la ta'khudhuhu sinatun wa la nawm. lahu ma fis-samawati wa ma fil-ard. man dhal-ladhi yashfa'u 'indahu illa bi-idhnihi. ya'lamu ma bayna aydihim wa ma khalfahum. wa la yuhituna bishay'in min 'ilmihi illa bima sha'. wa si'a kursiyyuhu as-samawati wal-ard. wa la ya'udu-hu hifdhuhuma. wa huwa al-'aliyyul-'azim
fh-dhikr-after-salah-8.translation: Allah - there is no deity except Him, the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of [all] existence. Neither drowsiness overtakes Him nor sleep. To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Who is it that can intercede with Him except by His permission? He knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them, and they encompass not a thing of His knowledge except for what He wills. His Kursi extends over the heavens and the earth, and their preservation tires Him not. And He is the Most High, the Most Great.
fh-dhikr-after-salah-8.reference: HR. an-Nasai in Al-Kubro 9: 44. This hadith is declared sahih by Ibn Hibban, as mentioned by Ibn Hajar in Bulugh al-Maram
fh-dhikr-after-salah-8.virtue: Whoever recites Ayat al-Kursi after finishing the prayer, nothing will prevent him from entering Paradise except death.

fh-dhikr-after-salah-9.title: Al-Ikhlas
fh-dhikr-after-salah-9.arabic: قُلْ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ (1) ٱللَّهُ ٱلصَّمَدُ (2) لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ (3) وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُۥ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌۢ (4)
fh-dhikr-after-salah-9.transliteration: qul huwa allahu ahad (1) allahu samad (2) lam yalid wa lam yulad (3) wa lam yakun lahu kufuwan ahad (4)
fh-dhikr-after-salah-9.translation: Say, "He is Allah , [who is] One, (1) Allah , the Eternal Refuge. (2) He neither begets nor is born, (3) Nor is there to Him any equivalent." (4)
fh-dhikr-after-salah-9.reference: HR. Abu Dawud No. 1523 and an-Nasa'i No. 1337. Al-Hafiz Abu Tahir said that the chain of this hadith is hasan
fh-dhikr-after-salah-9.virtue: The Messenger of Allah, sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam, said: Recite Qul huwallahu ahad, and Al-Mu'awwidhatayn (Al-Falaq and An-Nas) in the evening and morning three times, and it will suffice you (protect you) from everything.

fh-dhikr-after-salah-10.title: Al-Falaq
fh-dhikr-after-salah-10.arabic: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْفَلَقِ (1) مِن شَرِّ مَا خَلَقَ (2) وَمِن شَرِّ غَاسِقٍ إِذَا وَقَبَ (3) وَمِن شَرِّ ٱلنَّفَّٰثَٰتِ فِى ٱلْعُقَدِ (4) وَمِن شَرِّ حَاسِدٍ إِذَا حَسَدَ (5)
fh-dhikr-after-salah-10.transliteration: qul a'udhu birabbil-falaq (1) min sharri ma khalaq (2) wa min sharri ghasiqin idha waqab (3) wa min sharri naffathati fil-'uqad (4) wa min sharri hasidin idha hasad (5)
fh-dhikr-after-salah-10.translation: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak (1) From the evil of that which He created (2) And from the evil of darkness when it settles (3) And from the evil of the blowers in knots (4) And from the evil of an envier when he envies." (5)
fh-dhikr-after-salah-10.reference: HR. Abu Dawud No. 1523 and an-Nasa'i No. 1337. Al-Hafiz Abu Tahir said that the chain of this hadith is hasan
fh-dhikr-after-salah-10.virtue: The Messenger of Allah, sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam, said: Recite Qul huwallahu ahad, and Al-Mu'awwidhatayn (Al-Falaq and An-Nas) in the evening and morning three times, and it will suffice you (protect you) from everything.

fh-dhikr-after-salah-11.title: An-Nas
fh-dhikr-after-salah-11.arabic: قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلنَّاسِ (1) مَلِكِ ٱلنَّاسِ (2) إِلَٰهِ ٱلنَّاسِ (3) مِن شَرِّ ٱلْوَسْوَاسِ ٱلْخَنَّاسِ (4) ٱلَّذِى يُوَسْوِسُ فِى صُدُورِ ٱلنَّاسِ (5) مِنَ ٱلْجِنَّةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ (6)
fh-dhikr-after-salah-11.transliteration: qul a'udhu birabbin-nas (1) malikin-nas (2) ilahin-nas (3) min sharri al-waswasi al-khannas (4) alladhi yuwaswisu fi sudurin-nas (5) mina al-jinnati wan-nas (6)
fh-dhikr-after-salah-11.translation: Say, "I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind, (1) The King of mankind. (2) The God of mankind, (3) From the evil of the whisperer who withdraws, (4) Who whispers in the breasts of mankind, (5) Of the jinn and mankind." (6)
fh-dhikr-after-salah-11.reference: HR. Abu Dawud No. 1523 and an-Nasa'i No. 1337. Al-Hafiz Abu Tahir said that the chain of this hadith is hasan
fh-dhikr-after-salah-11.virtue: The Messenger of Allah, sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam, said: Recite Qul huwallahu ahad, and Al-Mu'awwidhatayn (Al-Falaq and An-Nas) in the evening and morning three times, and it will suffice you (protect you) from everything.

fh-dhikr-after-salah-12.title: Supplication for Beneficial Knowledge, Good Provision, and Accepted Deeds
fh-dhikr-after-salah-12.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّى أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْمًا نَافِعًا وَرِزْقًا طَيِّبًا وَعَمَلاً مُتَقَبَّلاً
fh-dhikr-after-salah-12.transliteration: allahumma inni as'aluka 'ilman nafi'an, wa rizqan tayyiban, wa 'amalan mutaqabbalan
fh-dhikr-after-salah-12.translation: O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, good provision, and accepted deeds.
fh-dhikr-after-salah-12.countLabel: Read 1x after the salam of Fajr prayer
fh-dhikr-after-salah-12.reference: HR. Ibn Majah No. 925 and Ahmad 6: 305, 322. Al-Hafiz Abu Tahir said that this hadith is sahih
fh-dhikr-after-salah-12.virtue: Beneficial knowledge is a provision that makes life easier, obtaining good provision is a person's goal in working, and accepted deeds are the hope of every person who performs good deeds. Therefore, a servant should always ask for these 3 things every morning before starting their various activities.

fh-daily-dua-0.title: Supplication Before Sleeping
fh-daily-dua-0.translation: In Your name, O Allah, I die and I live.
fh-daily-dua-0.virtue: The Prophet, sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam, always started and ended his day with dhikr.

fh-daily-dua-1.title: Supplication Upon Waking Up
fh-daily-dua-1.arabic: الحَمْدُ للهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بعْدَ مَا أماتَنَا وإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
fh-daily-dua-1.transliteration: alhamdulillahilladhi ahyana ba'da ma amatana wa ilayhin-nushur
fh-daily-dua-1.translation: All praise is for Allah who gives us life after He has caused us to die, and to Him is the resurrection.
fh-daily-dua-1.virtue: By reciting the supplication above, a servant begins his day by praising the name of Allah, the Giver of Life and the Bringer of Death.

fh-daily-dua-12.title: Supplication Entering the House #1
fh-daily-dua-12.virtue: The greeting is a supplication of hope, a hope that you will be safe from all kinds of sorrow and suffering, and be enveloped in mercy and blessings.

fh-daily-dua-13.title: Supplication Entering the House #2
fh-daily-dua-13.arabic: اَلسَّلَامُ عَلَيْكُمْ وَرَحْمَةُ اللهِ وَبَرَكَا تُهُ
fh-daily-dua-13.translation: Peace, mercy, and blessings of Allah be upon you.
fh-daily-dua-13.virtue: The greeting is a supplication of hope, a hope that you will be safe from all kinds of sorrow and suffering, and be enveloped in mercy and blessings.

fh-daily-dua-14.title: Supplication Leaving the House
fh-daily-dua-14.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ تَوَكَّلْتُ عَلَى اللَّهِ، لَا حَوْلَ وَلَا قُوَّةَ إِلَّا بِاللَّهِ
fh-daily-dua-14.transliteration: bismillah, tawakkaltu 'alallah, la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah
fh-daily-dua-14.translation: In the name of Allah, I place my trust in Allah. There is no might nor power except with Allah.
fh-daily-dua-14.virtue: Whoever recites this supplication, it will be said to him: "You will be guided, sufficed, and protected." Satan will then depart from him. Another satan will say: "How can you harm someone who has been guided, sufficed, and protected?!"

fh-daily-dua-15.title: Supplication for Protection from Causing or Experiencing Harm Outside the House
fh-daily-dua-15.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّى أَعُوذُ بِكَ أَنْ أَضِلَّ أَوْ أُضَلَّ أَوْ أَزِلَّ أَوْ أُزَلَّ أَوْ أَظْلِمَ أَوْ أُظْلَمَ أَوْ أَجْهَلَ أَوْ يُجْهَلَ عَلَىَّ
fh-daily-dua-15.transliteration: allahumma inni a'udhu bika an adilla aw udalla, aw azilla aw uzalla, aw adhlima aw udhlama, aw ajhala aw yujhala 'alayya
fh-daily-dua-15.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You lest I should stray or be led astray, slip or be tripped, wrong or be wronged, or act foolishly or have foolishness done to me.
fh-daily-dua-15.reference: HR. Abu Dawud, at-Tirmidzi, Ibn Majah and an-Nasa'i
fh-daily-dua-15.virtue: When a person leaves the house, they will encounter all kinds of things, both good and bad, especially harm caused by themselves. Therefore, it is commanded to seek refuge from oneself and from others.

fh-daily-dua-4.title: Supplication Before Eating
fh-daily-dua-4.reference: HR. al-Bukari No. 5376 and Muslim No. 2022
fh-daily-dua-4.virtue: The benefit of reciting Bismillah before eating is to prevent Satan from joining humans in eating.

fh-daily-dua-5.title: Supplication If Forgetting Bismillah at the Beginning of a Meal
fh-daily-dua-5.translation: In the name of Allah, at its beginning and its end.
fh-daily-dua-5.virtue: Islam pays great attention to etiquette. If someone forgets to recite the supplication before eating at the beginning, it is still recommended to recite it in the middle, even if there is only a spoonful of rice left.

fh-daily-dua-6.title: Supplication After Eating
fh-daily-dua-6.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِى أَطْعَمَنِى هَذَا وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّى وَلاَ قُوَّةٍ
fh-daily-dua-6.transliteration: alhamdulillahilladhi at'amani hadha wa razaqanihi min ghayri hawlin minni wa la quwwah
fh-daily-dua-6.translation: All praise is to Allah who has fed me this and provided for me without any power or strength from me.
fh-daily-dua-6.virtue: The Messenger of Allah, sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam, said that if someone recites this supplication, then his past sins will be forgiven.

fh-daily-dua-21.title: Supplication When Mounting a Vehicle
fh-daily-dua-21.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، الحَمْدُ للِه، سُبْحَانَ الَّذِى سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُونَ، سُبْحَانَكَ إِنِّى قَدْ ظَلَمْتُ نَفْسِى فَاغْفِرْ لِى فَإِنَّهُ لاَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ
fh-daily-dua-21.transliteration: bismillah, bismillah, bismillah, alhamdulillah, subhanalladhi sakhkhara lana hadha wa ma kunna lahu muqrinin. wa inna ila rabbina lamunqalibun. subhanaka inni qad dhalamtu nafsi, faghfir li fa innahu la yaghfirudh-dhunuba illa anta
fh-daily-dua-21.translation: In the name of Allah, in the name of Allah, in the name of Allah. All praise is to Allah. Glory be to Him who has subjected this to us, and we could not have done so by ourselves. And indeed, to our Lord we will return. Glory be to You, indeed I have wronged myself, so forgive me, for none can forgive sins except You.
fh-daily-dua-21.virtue: By reciting the supplication for mounting a vehicle, our journey will always be under the protection of Allah. In addition, we will also receive rewards, help, and a calmer heart.

fh-daily-dua-16.title: Travel Supplication
fh-daily-dua-16.arabic: الله أَكْبَرُ،الله أَكْبَرُ،الله أَكْبَرُ،سُبْحَانَ الَّذِى سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُونَ اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ فِى سَفَرِنَا هَذَا الْبِرَّ وَالتَّقْوَى وَمِنَ الْعَمَلِ مَا تَرْضَى اللَّهُمَّ هَوِّنْ عَلَيْنَا سَفَرَنَا هَذَا وَاطْوِ عَنَّا بُعْدَهُ اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الصَّاحِبُ فِى السَّفَرِ وَالْخَلِيفَةُ فِى الأَهْلِ اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّى أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ وَعْثَاءِ السَّفَرِ وَكَآبَةِ الْمَنْظَرِ وَسُوءِ الْمُنْقَلَبِ فِى الْمَالِ وَالأَهْلِ
fh-daily-dua-16.transliteration: allahu akbar, allahu akbar, allahu akbar. subhanalladhi sakhkhara lana hadha wa ma kunna lahu muqrinin wa inna ila rabbina lamunqalibun. allahumma inna nas'aluka fi safarina hadhal-birra wat-taqwa wa minal-'amali ma tarda. allahumma hawwin 'alayna safarana hadha watwi 'anna bu'dah. allahumma antas-sahibu fis-safar. wal-khalifatu fil-ahl. allahumma inni a'udhu bika min wa'tha'is-safar wa ka'abatil-mandhari wa su'il-munqalabi fil-mali wal-ahl
fh-daily-dua-16.translation: Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest, Allah is the Greatest. Glory be to Him who has provided this for us, though we could never have had it by our own efforts. Surely to our Lord we are returning. O Allah, we ask You for righteousness and piety in this journey of ours, and for deeds that please You. O Allah, lighten for us the hardship of this journey and quickly bring us to our destination. O Allah, You are our Companion on the journey and the Guardian of our families. O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the hardship of travel, from a bad return, and from seeing something unpleasant concerning our wealth, family, or children.
fh-daily-dua-16.virtue: This supplication has two parts. The first is praise of Allah and the submission of the servant. The second is a request to Allah for ease in travel and in the affairs of what the servant has left at home.

fh-daily-dua-17.title: Supplication of a Resident for Someone Who is Traveling
fh-daily-dua-17.arabic: أَسْتَوْدِعُ اللَّهَ دِينَكَ وَأَمَانَتَكَ وَخَوَاتِيمَ عَمَلِكَ
fh-daily-dua-17.transliteration: astawdi'ullaha dinaka, wa amanataka, wa khawatima 'amalik
fh-daily-dua-17.translation: I entrust your religion, your trust, and the end of your deeds to Allah.
fh-daily-dua-17.virtue: Three priorities of a servant that must be maintained everywhere: religion, trust, and deeds, because a person will be resurrected according to their deeds.

fh-daily-dua-18.title: Supplication for Piety from a Resident to Someone Who is Traveling
fh-daily-dua-18.arabic: زَوَّدَكَ اللَّهُ التَّقْوَى وَغَفَرَ ذَنْبَكَ  وَيَسَّرَ لَكَ الْخَيْرَ حَيْثُمَا كُنْتَ
fh-daily-dua-18.transliteration: zawwadakallahut-taqwa, wa ghafara dhanbaka, wa yassara lakal-khayra haythuma kunta
fh-daily-dua-18.translation: May Allah provide you with piety, forgive your sins, and ease goodness for you wherever you are.
fh-daily-dua-18.virtue: Piety is the best provision that a servant must prepare for the Hereafter, because there is no salvation except through piety.

fh-daily-dua-28.title: Supplication When Afflicted by Calamity
fh-daily-dua-28.arabic: إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ اللَّهُمَّ أْجُرْنِى فِى مُصِيبَتِى وَأَخْلِفْ لِى خَيْرًا مِنْهَا
fh-daily-dua-28.transliteration: inna lillahi wa inna ilayhi raji'un. allahumma'jurni fi musibati wa akhlif li khayran minha
fh-daily-dua-28.translation: Indeed we belong to Allah, and indeed to Him we will return. O Allah, reward me for my affliction and replace it with something better.
fh-daily-dua-28.virtue: A servant should recite the supplication above when afflicted by calamity with certainty and hope. Insha Allah, with this, they will receive a better replacement.

fh-daily-dua-30.title: Supplication for Protection from Laziness, Sadness, and Debt
fh-daily-dua-30.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ إِنِّى أَعُوْذُبِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزْنِ وَأَعُوْذُبِكَ مِنَ الْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ وَأَعُوْذُبِكَ مِنَ الْجُبْنِ وَالْبُخْلِ وَأَعُوْذُبِكَ مِنْ غَلَبَتِ الدَّيْنِ وَقَهْرِ الرجال
fh-daily-dua-30.transliteration: allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-hammi wal-hazan. wa a'udhu bika minal-'ajzi wal-kasal. wa a'udhu bika minal-jubni wal-bukhl. wa a'udhu bika min ghalabatid-dayni wa qahrir-rijal
fh-daily-dua-30.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from anxiety and grief, and I seek refuge in You from incapacity and laziness, and I seek refuge in You from cowardice and miserliness, and I seek refuge in You from being overpowered by debt and from being overcome by men.
fh-daily-dua-30.virtue: Abu Umamah then narrated: After I practiced this supplication, Allah truly removed my anxiety and gave me the ability to repay my debt.

fh-daily-dua-27.title: Supplication for Ease in All Matters
fh-daily-dua-27.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لاَ سَهْلَ إِلاَّ مَا جَعَلْتَهُ سَهْلاً وَأَنْتَ تَجْعَلُ الحَزْنَ إِذَا شِئْتَ سَهْلاً
fh-daily-dua-27.transliteration: allahumma la sahla illa ma ja'altahu sahla, wa anta taj'alul-hazna idha shi'ta sahla
fh-daily-dua-27.translation: O Allah, there is no ease except in that which You make easy, and You make the difficult easy if You wish.
fh-daily-dua-27.virtue: Ease comes only from Allah. Even something difficult can become easy Insha Allah.

fh-daily-dua-29.title: Supplication When in Debt
fh-daily-dua-29.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِى بِحَلاَلِكَ عَنْ حَرَامِكَ وَأَغْنِنِى بِفَضْلِكَ عَمَّنْ سِوَاكَ
fh-daily-dua-29.transliteration: allahummakfini bi halalika 'an haramik, wa aghnini bi fadlika 'amman siwak
fh-daily-dua-29.translation: O Allah, suffice me with what is lawful and keep me away from what is unlawful, and enrich me with Your bounty so I do not depend on anyone besides You.
fh-daily-dua-29.virtue: Lawful provision, even if it is little, is better than abundant unlawful wealth.

fh-selected-dua-5.title: Dua To Resist Affliction
fh-selected-dua-5.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ جَهْدِ البَلاَءِ ، وَدَرَكِ الشَّقَاءِ ، وَسُوءِ القَضَاءِ ، وَشَمَاتَةِ الأَعْدَاء
fh-selected-dua-5.transliteration: allahumma inni a'udhu bika min jahdil-bala', wa darakish-shaqa', wa su'il-qada', wa shamatatil-a'da'
fh-selected-dua-5.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from severe calamity, being overtaken by misery, evil destiny, and the triumphant mockery of enemies.
fh-selected-dua-5.virtue: Taking refuge from the provisions of fate that have a bad impact, does not contradict the attitude of being pleased with the provisions of the destiny of Allah azza wa jalla. Because asking for protection from the provision of Allah's destiny. Allah azza wa jalla could have predestined a disaster for someone, but Allah azza wa jalla also predestined that if he prays, Allah will remove the disaster.

fh-daily-dua-26.title: The Best Supplication for Seeking Forgiveness (Sayyid al-Istighfar)
fh-daily-dua-26.arabic: اَللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّيْ ، لَا إِلٰـهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ خَلَقْتَنِيْ وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ ، وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ ، أَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ ، أَبُوْءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمتِكَ عَلَيَّ ، وَأَبُوْءُ بِذَنْبِيْ فَاغْفِرْ لِيْ ، فَإِنَّهُ لَا يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ
fh-daily-dua-26.transliteration: allahumma anta rabbi la ilaha illa anta khalaqtani wa ana 'abduka wa ana 'ala 'ahdika wa wa'dika mastata'tu a'udhu bika min sharri ma sana'tu abu'u laka bini'matika 'alayya wa abu'u bidhanbi faghfir li fa innahu la yaghfirudh-dhunuba illa anta
fh-daily-dua-26.translation: O Allah, You are my Lord. There is no deity worthy of worship except You. You created me, and I am Your servant. I abide to Your covenant and promise as best I can. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I acknowledge Your blessings upon me, and I acknowledge my sin. So forgive me, for none can forgive sins except You.
fh-daily-dua-26.reference: HR. al-Bukhari No. 6306, 6323, Ahmad IV/122-125, an-Nasa'i VIII/279-280
fh-daily-dua-26.virtue: Whoever recites it with certainty in the evening, and then he dies, he will enter Paradise, and likewise if (recited) in the morning.

fh-morning-dhikr-18.title: Istighfar 100x a Day
fh-morning-dhikr-18.translation: I seek forgiveness from Allah and repent to Him.
fh-morning-dhikr-18.reference: HR. al-Bukhari/Fat-hul Baari XI/101 and Muslim No. 2702
fh-morning-dhikr-18.virtue: Ibn 'Umar said: The Messenger of Allah, sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam, said: 'O people, repent to Allah, for indeed I repent to Him one hundred times a day'.

fh-daily-dua-37.title: Prayer for Forgiveness for Parents
fh-daily-dua-37.arabic: رَبَّنَا ٱغْفِرْ لِى وَلِوَٰلِدَىَّ وَلِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ يَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلْحِسَابُ
fh-daily-dua-37.transliteration: rabbanaghfir li wa liwalidayya wa lil-mu'minina yawma yaqumul-hisab
fh-daily-dua-37.translation: Our Lord, forgive me and my parents and all the believers on the Day the account is established.
fh-daily-dua-37.virtue: This is a prayer of Prophet Ibrahim (peace be upon him), teaching us to honor and love our parents, remember the Day of Judgment, and care for fellow believers. By making this prayer, we hope that Allah will forgive our sins and make us among the faithful.

fh-selected-dua-0.title: Dua Seeking Good In This World And In The Hereafter
fh-selected-dua-0.arabic: رَبَّنَا آَتِنَا فِي الدُّنْيَا حَسَنَةً وَفِي الْآَخِرَةِ حَسَنَةً وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
fh-selected-dua-0.transliteration: rabbana atina fid-dunya hasanatan wa fil-akhirati hasanatan wa qina 'adhaban-nar
fh-selected-dua-0.translation: Our Lord! Give us good in this world and give us good in the Hereafter, and save us from the torment of the hell fire.
fh-selected-dua-0.virtue: This dua is the dua most often said by the Prophet sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam, as told by sahaba Anas bin Malik radhiallahu anhu.

fh-selected-dua-3.title: Dua To Make Heart Firm Upon Deen #3
fh-selected-dua-3.arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا
fh-selected-dua-3.transliteration: rabbana la tuzigh qulubana ba'da idh hadaytana
fh-selected-dua-3.translation: O our Lord, do not make our hearts incline to error after You have guided us.
fh-selected-dua-3.virtue: A person's heart is between the fingers of Allah ta'ala, and He turns it back and forth according to his will. So, it is appropriate for someone to always ask that Allah will set their heart on goodness, and always be istiqamah in the truth.

fh-daily-dua-35.title: Prayer for Protection from Satan
fh-daily-dua-35.arabic: رَبِّ أَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ هَمَزَاتِ الشَّيَاطِيْنِ وَأَعُوْذُ بِكَ رَبِّ أَنْ يَحْضُرُوْنِ
fh-daily-dua-35.transliteration: rabbi a'udhu bika min hamazatish-shayatin wa a'udhu bika rabbi ay-yahdurun
fh-daily-dua-35.translation: My Lord, I seek refuge in You from the whispers of Satan, and I seek refuge in You, my Lord, from their presence around me.
fh-daily-dua-35.virtue: Indeed, Allah commands the Prophet Muhammad and all his followers to seek refuge from the whispers of Satan in all activities, especially when approaching death. Satan whispers evil into the hearts of humans, encouraging wrongdoing.

fh-daily-dua-9.title: Supplication Before Performing Ablution
fh-daily-dua-9.virtue: It is prescribed to begin every important matter by saying Bismillah, whether it be an act of worship or otherwise.

fh-daily-dua-10.title: Supplication After Performing Ablution
fh-daily-dua-10.arabic: أشْهَدُ أنْ لا إله إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لا شَرِيك لَهُ ، وأشْهَدُ أنَّ مُحَمَّداً عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ ، اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْنِي مِنَ التَوَّابِينَ ، واجْعَلْني مِنَ المُتَطَهِّرِينَ ، سُبْحانَكَ اللَّهُمَّ وبِحَمْدِكَ ، أشْهَدُ أنْ لا إلهَ إِلاَّ أنْتَ ، أسْتَغْفِرُكَ وأتُوبُ إِلَيْكَ
fh-daily-dua-10.transliteration: ashhadu alla ilaha illa allah wahdahu la sharika lahu, wa ashhadu anna muhammadan 'abduhu wa rasuluh. allahummaj'alni minat-tawwabina waj'alni minal-mutatahhirin. subhanakallahumma wa bihamdika ashhadu alla ilaha illa anta astaghfiruka wa atubu ilayk
fh-daily-dua-10.translation: I bear witness that there is no deity except Allah alone, with no partner, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and Messenger. O Allah, make me among those who repent and make me among those who purify themselves. Glory be to You, O Allah, and with Your praise, I bear witness that there is no deity except You. I seek Your forgiveness and repent to You.
fh-daily-dua-10.virtue: Whoever recites this supplication, eight gates of Paradise will be opened for him, and he may enter from whichever gate he wishes.

fh-daily-dua-7.title: Supplication Entering the Mosque
fh-daily-dua-7.translation: O Allah, open the doors of Your mercy for me.
fh-daily-dua-7.virtue: The mosque is the house of Allah; a servant should honor it and hope for Allah's mercy within it.

fh-daily-dua-8.title: Supplication Leaving the Mosque
fh-daily-dua-8.translation: O Allah, I ask You for Your bounty.
fh-daily-dua-8.virtue: Allah's earth is vast, and there are many ways to seek provision. A servant should ask for Allah's bounty to be facilitated in obtaining the provision that Allah has distributed to all His servants.

fh-daily-dua-36.title: Prayer After the Adhan
fh-daily-dua-36.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ رَبَّ هَذِهِ الدَّعْوَةِ التَّامَّةِ، وَالصَّلَاةِ الْقَائِمَةِ، آتِ مُحَمَّدًا الْوَسِيلَةَ وَالْفَضِيلَةَ، وَابْعَثْهُ مَقَامًا مَحْمُودًا الَّذِي وَعَدْتَهُ
fh-daily-dua-36.transliteration: allahumma rabba hadhihid-da'watit-tammah, was-salatil-qa'imah, ati muhammadanil-wasilata wal-fadilah, wab'ath-hu maqaman mahmudanilladhi wa'adtah
fh-daily-dua-36.translation: O Allah, Lord of this perfect call and the established prayer, grant Muhammad the wasilah (a high status in Paradise) and the excellence (above all creation), and raise him to the praiseworthy station that You have promised him.
fh-daily-dua-36.reference: Narrated by Abu Dawud (529), at-Tirmidhi (211), an-Nasa'i (2:26), Ibn Majah (722)
fh-daily-dua-36.virtue: This prayer is recommended by the Prophet Muhammad sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam for those who hear the call to prayer. It has many benefits, including receiving intercession from the Prophet on the Day of Judgment, attaining the wasilah and honor in Paradise for the Prophet, and receiving great and commendable reward from Allah. It is also a way to show respect and admiration for Allah and His Messenger, expressing love and longing for the Prophet Muhammad, the role model for Muslims.

fh-daily-dua-20.title: Supplication When Wearing Clothes
fh-daily-dua-20.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِى كَسَانِى هَذَا الثَّوْبَ وَرَزَقَنِيهِ مِنْ غَيْرِ حَوْلٍ مِنِّى وَلاَ قُوَّةٍ
fh-daily-dua-20.transliteration: alhamdulillahilladhi kasani hadha wa razaqanihi min ghayri hawlin minni wa la quwwah
fh-daily-dua-20.translation: Praise be to Allah who has clothed me with this garment and provided it for me without any power or strength from me.
fh-daily-dua-20.reference: HR. all compilers of Sunan books, except Nasa'i
fh-daily-dua-20.virtue: The virtue of reciting this supplication is that past sins will be forgiven, Insha Allah.

fh-daily-dua-19.title: Supplication When Wearing New Clothes
fh-daily-dua-19.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ الْحَمْدُ أَنْتَ كَسَوْتَنِيهِ أَسْأَلُكَ مِنْ خَيْرِهِ وَخَيْرِ مَا صُنِعَ لَهُ وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهِ وَشَرِّ مَا صُنِعَ لَهُ
fh-daily-dua-19.transliteration: allahumma lakal-hamdu anta kasawtanihi. as'aluka min khayrihi wa khayri ma suni'a lah, wa a'udhu bika min sharrihi wa sharri ma suni'a lah
fh-daily-dua-19.translation: O Allah, to You is all praise. You have clothed me with this. I ask You for its goodness and the goodness for which it was made, and I seek refuge in You from its evil and the evil for which it was made.
fh-daily-dua-19.reference: HR. Ahmad, Abu Dawud, at-Tirmidzi and Al-Hakim
fh-daily-dua-19.virtue: By reciting this supplication, one asks that the clothes they have bought may provide goodness and also be a protection against various evils.

fh-daily-dua-22.title: Supplication When it Rains
fh-daily-dua-22.translation: O Allah, make it a beneficial rain.
fh-daily-dua-22.virtue: It is encouraged to pray when it rains so that goodness and blessings increase, as well as its benefits.

fh-daily-dua-23.title: Supplication During Heavy Rain
fh-daily-dua-23.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ حَوَالَيْنَا وَلاَ عَلَيْنَا ، اللَّهُمَّ عَلَى الآكَامِ وَالظِّرَابِ وَبُطُونِ الأَوْدِيَةِ وَمَنَابِتِ الشَّجَرِ
fh-daily-dua-23.transliteration: allahumma hawalayna wa la 'alayna. allahumma 'alal-akami wadh-dhirabi, wa butunil-awdiyati, wa manabitish-shajar
fh-daily-dua-23.translation: O Allah, (let the rain fall) around us, not on us. O Allah, (let it fall) on the hills, mountains, small mountains, valleys, and places where trees grow.
fh-daily-dua-23.virtue: The supplication above is recited when the rain gets heavier or there is a concern that the rain will cause harm.

fh-daily-dua-24.title: Supplication After it Rains
fh-daily-dua-24.translation: We have been given rain by the bounty and mercy of Allah.
fh-daily-dua-24.reference: HR. al-Bukhari No. 846 and Muslim No. 71
fh-daily-dua-24.virtue: By reciting this supplication, one believes that rain falls by the will of Allah (Allah's virtue), not by the stars, so they do not become disbelievers in Allah.

fh-daily-dua-25.title: Supplication During Strong Wind
fh-daily-dua-25.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا، وَأَعُوْذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا
fh-daily-dua-25.transliteration: allahumma inni as'aluka khayraha wa a'udhu bika min sharriha
fh-daily-dua-25.translation: O Allah, I ask You for the good of this wind, and I seek refuge in You from its evil.
fh-daily-dua-25.reference: HR. Abu Dawud and Ibn Majah
fh-daily-dua-25.virtue: Among the signs of Allah's power is a strong wind that can bring blessings and punishment, namely good and bad. Therefore, a servant should continue to ask for good and seek refuge from all harm.

fh-daily-dua-2.title: Supplication Entering the Bathroom
fh-daily-dua-2.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْخُبُثِ وَالْخَبَائِثِ
fh-daily-dua-2.transliteration: allahumma inni a'udhu bika minal-khubuthi wal-khaba'ith
fh-daily-dua-2.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the evil and the wicked.
fh-daily-dua-2.virtue: This supplication acts as a barrier between a servant's private parts and the jinn when entering the bathroom.

fh-daily-dua-3.title: Supplication Leaving the Bathroom
fh-daily-dua-3.translation: I ask for Your forgiveness (O Allah).
fh-daily-dua-3.virtue: The bathroom is one of the homes of the jinn and devils, so it is recommended to ask for forgiveness for any mistakes, intentional or unintentional, made while in the bathroom.

fh-daily-dua-31.title: Supplication After Sneezing
fh-daily-dua-31.virtue: Indeed, Allah loves sneezing because it moves a person to worship. It is encouraged to respond to the praise of Allah by someone who praises Allah, and vice versa.

fh-daily-dua-32.title: Supplication Upon Hearing Someone Sneeze
fh-daily-dua-32.translation: May Allah have mercy on you.
fh-daily-dua-32.virtue: Indeed, Allah loves sneezing because it moves a person to worship. It is encouraged to respond to the praise of Allah by someone who praises Allah, and vice versa.

fh-daily-dua-33.title: Response to Someone Who Says 'Yarhamukallah' After You Sneeze
fh-daily-dua-33.translation: May Allah guide you and improve your condition.
fh-daily-dua-33.virtue: Indeed, Allah loves sneezing because it moves a person to worship. It is encouraged to respond to the praise of Allah by someone who praises Allah, and vice versa.

fh-daily-dua-11.title: Supplication for Breaking the Fast
fh-daily-dua-11.arabic: ذَهَبَ الظَّمَأُ وابْتَلَّتِ الْعُرُوقُ وثَبَتَ اْلأَجْرُ إِنْ شَاءَاللهُ
fh-daily-dua-11.transliteration: dhahabadh-dhama'u wabtallatil-'uruqu wa thabatal-ajru insha allah
fh-daily-dua-11.translation: The thirst has gone, the veins are moistened, and the reward is confirmed, Insha Allah.
fh-daily-dua-11.reference: HR. Abu Daud, As-Sunan Al-Kubra Lil Baihaqi, Vol. 4, p. 239, al-Hakim in Mustadrak 'alas Shahihain No. 1484
fh-daily-dua-11.virtue: It is highly recommended for those who are fasting to increase their supplications before and after breaking the fast, because the supplication of a fasting person is one of the three supplications that are not rejected.

fh-selected-dua-1.title: Dua To Make Heart Firm Upon Deen #1
fh-selected-dua-1.arabic: يَا مُقَلِّبَ الْقُلُوبِ ثَبِّتْ قَلْبِى عَلَى دِينِكَ
fh-selected-dua-1.translation: O Changer of the hearts, make my heart firm upon Your religion.
fh-selected-dua-1.virtue: A person's heart is between the fingers of Allah ta'ala, and He turns it back and forth according to his will. So, it is appropriate for someone to always ask that Allah will set their heart on goodness, and always be istiqamah in the truth.

fh-selected-dua-2.title: Dua To Make Heart Firm Upon Deen #2
fh-selected-dua-2.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ مُصَرِّفَ الْقُلُوبِ صَرِّفْ قُلُوبَنَا عَلَى طَاعَتِكَ
fh-selected-dua-2.translation: O Allah! Controller of the hearts, direct our hearts to Your obedience.
fh-selected-dua-2.virtue: A person's heart is between the fingers of Allah ta'ala, and He turns it back and forth according to his will. So, it is appropriate for someone to always ask that Allah will set their heart on goodness, and always be istiqamah in the truth.

fh-selected-dua-4.title: Dua To Seek Refuge Against The Loss Of Pleasure
fh-selected-dua-4.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّى أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ زَوَالِ نِعْمَتِكَ وَتَحَوُّلِ عَافِيَتِكَ وَفُجَاءَةِ نِقْمَتِكَ وَجَمِيعِ سَخَطِكَ
fh-selected-dua-4.transliteration: allahumma inni a'udhu bika min zawali ni'matik, wa tahawwuli 'afiyatik, wa fuja'ati niqmatik, wa jami'i sakhatik
fh-selected-dua-4.translation: O Allah, I seek refuge in You from the loss of the pleasures that You have bestowed, from changes in the health that You have bestowed, from Your sudden torment, and from all Your wrath.
fh-selected-dua-4.virtue: The pleasures of being present at this time are very likely to be lost, the health of our souls and bodies in a blink of an eye can turn into illness, and only Allah can prevent that from happening.

fh-selected-dua-7.title: Dua When Getting Good News
fh-selected-dua-7.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِى بِنِعْمَتِهِ تَتِمُّ الصَّالِحَاتُ
fh-selected-dua-7.transliteration: alhamdu lillahi alladhi bini'matihi tattimmu assalihat
fh-selected-dua-7.translation: Praise be to Allah, by whose grace goodness is perfected.
fh-selected-dua-7.reference: HR. Ibn Majah in the Sunan, No. 3803 and al-Hakim in al-Mustadrak (1/499)
fh-selected-dua-7.virtue: Aisha radhiyallahu 'anha said, Rasulullah sallallahu 'alayhi wa sallam when he saw something he liked, he read the sentence above.

fh-daily-dua-34.title: Supplication for Good Character
fh-daily-dua-34.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ كَمَا حَسَّنْتَ خَلْقِي فَحَسِّنْ خُلُقِي
fh-daily-dua-34.transliteration: allahumma kama hassanta khalqi fahassin khuluqi
fh-daily-dua-34.translation: O Allah, just as You have made my external form good, make my character good as well.
fh-daily-dua-34.reference: HR. Ahmad, authenticated by al-Albani in al-Irwa', 1/115
fh-daily-dua-34.virtue: A charming appearance is not enough provision for a Muslim, but it must be accompanied by noble character. Therefore, a Muslim should constantly ask for their character to be improved and beautified.
